blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No Filipinos were reported dead or injured following the two powerful earthquakes that struck Panama on Friday, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) said Sunday. “According to the Philippine Embassy in Mexico, no injuries or casualties involving Filipino nationals in Panama have been reported,” DFA spokesperson Analyn Ratonel told reporters in a message.
